_meta.description: Post-BLP canonical core dataset for Geometria Iuris Ch.3 (Methodology of Legal Sciences thesis, LUISS). Each entry is a HK Cap. bilingual legal term selected by manual curation from the K_postBLP≥4 long list (1271 candidates) with ZH wrong-sense glosses corrected against the corpus.

encoding_instructions.aggregation: mean over attested contexts per language; no synthetic padding
encoding_instructions.note: When zh_postBLP_override_applied=true, zh_clean_postBLP differs from zh_clean; the override form is the form actually attested in the post-1989 corpus and should be used as the encoding input.
